text.緑豊かなバルコニーと借景の見え方を検討しながら、間取りを大きく変更。世界各国で集: The plan was substantially rearranged, working from how the planted balcony and the borrowed landscape beyond would be seen. What holds the collection gathered from around the world, and the folding screens handed down in the family, is solid birch laid in herringbone and lime plaster on the walls and ceilings. This is a fine apartment renovation given not to showy opulence but to the refined texture of natural materials.
text.熟練職人が滑らかでいて、味のある風合いに仕上げています。質感ある漆喰壁は、住まい: Laid by a skilled plasterer, smooth and full of character. The texture of the plaster wall makes a room in which the paintings and screens that furnish the home are shown at their best.
text.ヘリンボーン貼りとしたバーチの無垢材は、床暖房にも対応。軽やかな色ながら自然素材: Solid birch laid in herringbone, suitable for use over underfloor heating. Light in colour, yet with the sheen peculiar to a natural material and a weight that is never loud, it gives a large space a rich expression.
text.日常家族の集うキッチンカウンターは、マホガニーの無垢材を使用しています。無垢材の: The kitchen counter the family gathers at every day is solid mahogany. A solid timber counter is soft to the touch and gains character with use.
text.若干の艶感のあるイギリス製の水性ペイントを使用。人体に有害なVOC（揮発性有機化: An English water-based paint with a slight sheen. It is free of the volatile organic compounds (VOCs) harmful to people, and at home it has been used in the restoration of castles. Natural pigments, no smell, a smooth finish.
